title: Replace 30-day fixed evaluation window with a rolling perpetual model (currently day 199/30)
description: The firm is on day 199/30 of a fixed trading window. Fixed-window evaluation creates end-of-horizon distortions: agents and managers behave differently when the 'clock is running out'. More importantly, when day 30 ends, institutional memory resets. Proposal: remove the 30-day limit. Run perpetually. Generate a quarterly benchmark report (vs. SPY, QQQ, sector ETFs) every 63 trading days. Evaluate the firm on rolling 30/63/252-day Sharpe ratio, not a single fixed window. This is how real hedge funds measure themselves.
auto_fix_hint: In state.json, replace `paper_day` counter with `trading_day_total` (never resets). Add `quarterly_benchmark_day` that triggers a benchmark report every 63 days. In main.py, remove the day-30 termination condition. Report generator shows trailing 30/63-day Sharpe vs. benchmark instead of 'Day X/30'.

title: Replace 30-day fixed evaluation window with a rolling perpetual model (currently day 209/30)
description: The firm is on day 209/30 of a fixed trading window. Fixed-window evaluation creates end-of-horizon distortions: agents and managers behave differently when the 'clock is running out'. Generate a quarterly benchmark report (vs. SPY, QQQ, sector ETFs) every 63 trading days. Evaluate the firm on rolling 30/63/252-day Sharpe ratio, not a single fixed window. This is how real hedge funds measure themselves.
auto_fix_hint: In state.json, replace `paper_day` counter with `trading_day_total` (never resets). Add `quarterly_benchmark_day` that triggers a benchmark report every 63 days. title: Replace 30-day fixed evaluation window with a rolling perpetual model (currently day 218/30)
description: The firm is on day 218/30 of a fixed trading window. Fixed-window evaluation creates end-of-horizon distortions: agents and managers behave differently when the 'clock is running out'. More importantly, when day 30 ends, institutional memory resets. Proposal: remove the 30-day limit. Run perpetually. Generate a quarterly benchmark report (vs. SPY, QQQ, sector ETFs) every 63 trading days. Evaluate the firm on rolling 30/63/252-day Sharpe ratio, not a single fixed window. This is how real hedge funds measure themselves.
